memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: Neurology Department, Vikram Hospital
Reason: First‑break seizure disorder; optimize anti‑epileptic therapy; consider EEG video monitoring.
Clinical details: 19‑year‑old male on levetiracetam 750 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, seizure free for 8 weeks. Baseline labs normal.
Request: Opinion on long‑term management and possible drug taper.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
From Neurology, Vikram Hospital
Assessment: Epilepsy well controlled; medication appropriate.
Recommendation: Continue current regimen for at least 12 months before considering taper; repeat EEG in 6 months.
No urgent intervention needed.
